payload.action_summary: Implement Klimat Central Hub FSM per specs/climate_ui_adjustments.md and ADR 0029: OFF hub turn_on; DEFAULT_ON↔EDIT_TEMP; Power→Cancel abort; container-scoped TEMP blur; 270° horseshoe matching wheel outer; value cold→warm arc/thumb gradient; keep radial node press/haptic/glow (ADR 0028).
preserve_behavior: Deferred setpoint commit: climate.set_temperature once on hub commit while EDIT_TEMP; no on-drag HA spam
Cancel (X) and any non-commit dismiss revert pending temp/fill/thumb to live entity
Timer radial mutex with TEMP (.lg-timer-radial-open ⟂ .lg-wheel-temp-open) unchanged (ADR 0025)
Wheel layer segment counts and HA mode/fan payloads unchanged (ADR 0019)
Floor/house climate off remain hold-to-off; room off in DEFAULT_ON remains tap turn_off (ADR 0016)
No retune of shared light tokens (lg_size_switch_*, disable_room_button) — climate-scoped only (ADR 0014)
Option 1 CSS only: lg_* tokens + extra_styles; no inline style / native button-card styles (ADR 0006)
Fluid units only — no hardcoded px (ADR 0007)
Radial Interactive Node press/active/disabled parity with lighting pills retained (ADR 0028 §§1-4,6-7)
